items.title: Strata 0.2.12 speeds local prompts on 12 GB GPUs, Strix Halo, and Mac
items.summary: Strata 0.2.12 ships a tuned DFlash2 drafter and measured prompt speedups: about 3x on RTX 3060-class 12 GB cards (87 to 264 tok/s at 2K), up to about 2x on Strix Halo Windows and nearly 3x on Linux, plus roughly 10 to 14% on Mac M5 Max. It also fixes many Claude Desktop and Anthropic-style tool-call bugs. Known losses include JSON extraction on the 3060 (-18.9%) and some Strix Halo tool-call regressions.

doubt.pushback: Release notes own the JSON and tool-call regressions; one replier could not reproduce a claimed longer-prompt SSD gain and was told their install mixed forks.

reception.summary: Local builders thank Niko and report updating; several ask about Strix Halo, SSD streaming, and Arc; one user flagged a link stub PR and another could not verify an SSD prompt claim until cleaning mixed forks.

items.title: Underdog Woof is a 31 to 41 MB CPU TTS with measured hard-case word error
items.summary: Conway Research released Underdog Woof, a tiny English text-to-speech model that runs on CPU with numpy only. The one-voice build is 31.7 MB; the two-voice Hugging Face build is 40.6 MB and reports 1.42% word error on Gradium TTS Hard Cases with about 13.8x real-time on one M5 Max CPU thread. License is non-commercial by default.

doubt.pushback: Vendor-run benchmark table; commercial use needs a paid license.

items.title: Amp ships an experimental native Windows app
items.summary: Sourcegraph Amp opened an experimental Windows desktop app for bug reports, with the same early-access pattern used for Android. Download is at ampcode.com/app?windows; Linux remains WIP via community packages.

items.title: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention compresses the KV-cache into a searchable tree
items.summary: Zyphra's ZHA paper organizes the KV-cache as a tree of compressed summaries so queries only attend to a small fraction of tokens. With about 1B tokens of distillation it keeps most full-attention quality up to 35B parameters, scoring 93.3% vs 96% on RULER at 256K while attending to about 1 to 6% of the cache.

doubt.pushback: Surfaced via alphaXiv aggregator; no lab X original found in-window.

items.title: Latent Sparse Attention claims large prefill speedups at 10M-token context
items.summary: The LSA paper clusters similar tokens into a searchable hierarchy so sparse attention can find relevant tokens without scanning the whole context. At 10M tokens it reports one attention layer 22.7x faster in prefill and 4.6x faster in decode than GLM-5.3-Flash's sparse attention, at similar accuracy.

doubt.pushback: Aggregator summary only; primary lab account not identified in-window.
